as_told.title: Hillary Clinton's planned UFO answer on Kimmel goes unasked

plain: In the Podesta emails, messages from John Podesta, the chairman of Hillary Clinton's 2016 presidential campaign, which were leaked and published in 2016, there is said to be talk of a seven-year plan to promote UFO material. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron says Podesta wanted the talk show host Jimmy Kimmel to ask Clinton about aliens when she went on his show, but Kimmel did not ask the UFO question. Cameron, summarising the emails without quoting them, dates the appearance to November 2015 and adds that she was furious. To him it shows a presidential campaign planning to bring UFOs into the open.
